message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "on: [push]

name: build/linux

# This is currently needed to build the http3 functionality in the reqwest crate
env:
  RUSTFLAGS: '--cfg reqwest_unstable'

jobs:
  check:
    name: dash-mpd-rs check/nightly
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 100
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
           fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-nightly-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cargo-hack
      - name: Install ffmpeg + protoc
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get -y install ffmpeg libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libavutil-dev libswscale-dev protobuf-compiler cmake libxml2-utils
          cargo check
          cargo hack check --feature-powerset --no-dev-deps --skip socks,http3,xee-xslt

  test:
    name: dash-mpd-rs test/stable
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 100
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
           fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-stable-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Install ffmpeg + GPAC + mediainfo
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get -y install ffmpeg libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libavutil-dev libswscale-dev gpac mediainfo 
          MP4Box -version

      - name: Install mkvmerge
        run: sudo apt install mkvtoolnix

      - name: Install Bento4 mp4decrypt
        run: |
          wget -q -O /tmp/bento4.zip https://www.bok.net/Bento4/binaries/Bento4-SDK-1-6-0-641.x86_64-unknown-linux.zip
          unzip /tmp/bento4.zip "Bento4-SDK-*/bin/mp4decrypt" -d /tmp
          sudo mv /tmp/Bento4-SDK*/bin/mp4decrypt /usr/local/bin

      - name: Install shaka-packager
        run: |
          wget -q -O /tmp/shaka-packager https://github.com/shaka-project/shaka-packager/releases/latest/download/packager-linux-x64
          mv /tmp/shaka-packager /usr/local/bin
          chmod +x /usr/local/bin/shaka-packager

      - name: Install xsltproc + protoc
        run: sudo apt-get -y install xsltproc protobuf-compiler cmake libxml2-utils

      # The Github runners are failing the container-based tests with a "cannot retrieve cmd line"
      # error from podman.
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          RUST_LOG=info cargo test --jobs 1 --test muxing -- --show-output --test-threads=1
          RUST_LOG=info cargo test --jobs 1 -- --test-threads=1 --skip container
          # cargo test --jobs 1 --all-features -- --test-threads=1 --skip container
          cargo run --example download_bbc",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly downloads Rust crate dependencies from the cargo registry on every run with no caching. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (dependency_cache, observational evidence from the ICSE 2024 GitHub Actions workflow study) supports caching dependency download state to save CI resources, with preconditions met: repeated dependency fetching occurs each run, and cache inputs can include the lockfile and environment. The change adds actions/cache@v4 steps restoring only ~/.cargo/registry and ~/.cargo/git (dependency downloads, not unchecked build outputs), keyed by runner OS, toolchain channel, and Cargo.lock hash. All original build/test commands, timeouts, permissions, and required checks are preserved; no privileged actions, secrets, publishing, or new network access are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
